name: mbse-evidence-review
description: Evidence-linked review of systems engineering requirements, architecture and verification traceability.

interface.longDescription: Trace requirements through architectural allocations and verification records, identify evidence gaps and baseline inconsistencies, and produce findings with closure criteria. This is review assistance, not certification or safety approval.
defaultPrompt: Review these requirements and architecture artifacts for traceability gaps.
Assess the verification evidence in this synthetic engineering bundle.
Find unsupported assurance claims and give a corrective-action backlog.
